verdict.reasons: Core defect: While the primary 'AFP' and 'Drip Irrigation Tape' text is correct, the small Persian text ('آبگسترفراپارس') is rendered as AI-gibberish in the main image. In the detailed crop on the left, the text is inverted (white text on the blue band) which is typographically contradictory and further confirms the text is not authentically integrated but generated. This constitutes a 'fake_text_or_logo' defect.

focused_physical_review.reason: A broad, continuous soil gap is visible around the complete footprint of the white-and-blue AFP package. Irrigation lines are present in the furrows to the right and in the background, but no line crosses the package base or axis. There are no extra loose coils outside the required package, and no protruding strips, ribbons, or tails are visible on the carton sides or base.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
